# CU-ID: arch
# CU-TYPE: ArchCU
# DTR-COORDINATES: 

Hexagonal architecture for the Scala Hypothesis Engine. Layer order DOMAIN, APPLICATION, INFRASTRUCTURE, CONTROL. Domain holds immutable models only. Application owns ports and services. Infrastructure provides adapters. Control performs DI wiring and CLI entry. No cross-layer imports: domain imports nothing from application/infrastructure/control; application imports domain only; infrastructure imports application and domain; control imports all. Dependencies are injected through constructors; no service locators. Severity: every CU is CRITICAL unless downgraded explicitly.

```scala
package hypothesisengine.domain

import java.time.Instant

opaque type HypothesisId = String
object HypothesisId:
  def apply(value: String): HypothesisId = value
  def value(id: HypothesisId): String = id

opaque type DtrCoordinate = String
object DtrCoordinate:
  def apply(value: String): DtrCoordinate = value
  def value(coordinate: DtrCoordinate): String = coordinate

opaque type ExecutionId = String
object ExecutionId:
  def apply(value: String): ExecutionId = value
  def value(id: ExecutionId): String = id

enum Runtime:
  case Python, Scala

final case class Hypothesis(
  id: HypothesisId,
  statement: String,
  coordinates: Vector[DtrCoordinate],
  gate: Double,
  prior: Double
)

final case class ExperimentDefinition(
  experimentId: String,
  hypothesisId: HypothesisId,
  runtime: Runtime,
  command: Vector[String],
  workingDirectory: String,
  timeoutSeconds: Int,
  testArtifactVersion: String
)

final case class RawResult(
  executionId: ExecutionId,
  hypothesisId: HypothesisId,
  experimentId: String,
  testArtifactVersion: String,
  command: Vector[String],
  environment: Map[String, String],
  sourceRevision: String,
  timeoutSeconds: Int,
  exitCode: Int,
  stdout: String,
  stderr: String,
  durationMillis: Long,
  recordedAt: Instant
)

final case class NormalizedResult(
  executionId: ExecutionId,
  hypothesisId: HypothesisId,
  passed: Boolean,
  detail: String
)

final case class Breakpoint(
  coordinate: DtrCoordinate,
  executionId: ExecutionId,
  detail: String
)

final case class SuggestedFix(
  targets: Vector[DtrCoordinate],
  description: String
)

final case class AdvisorActionRequired(
  missing: Vector[String],
  corrections: Vector[String]
)

final case class ProbabilityCalculation(
  hypothesisId: HypothesisId,
  posterior: Double,
  calculatedAt: Instant
)

enum Decision:
  case Green(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, posterior: Double, gate: Double)
  case Red(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, posterior: Double, gate: Double, breakpoints: Vector[Breakpoint], fix: SuggestedFix)
  case Blocked(reason: AdvisorActionRequired)
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine.infrastructure

import java.nio.file.{Files, Path}

object DotEnv:
  def load(root: Path): Map[String, String] =
    val discovered: Option[Path] = walkUp(root.toAbsolutePath.normalize())
      .find(candidate => Files.isRegularFile(candidate.resolve(".env")))
    val raw: Map[String, String] = discovered.map(path => parse(path.resolve(".env"))).getOrElse(Map.empty)
    val env: Map[String, String] = raw ++ sys.env.toMap
    raw.map { case (key, value) => key -> expand(value, env, 0) }

  private def walkUp(current: Path): List[Path] =
    val parent: Path = current.getParent
    if parent == null then List(current) else current :: walkUp(parent)

  private def parse(path: Path): Map[String, String] =
    val lines: List[String] = scala.io.Source.fromFile(path.toFile).getLines().toList
    lines.flatMap { line: String =>
      val trimmed: String = line.trim
      if trimmed.isEmpty || trimmed.startsWith("#") then None
      else
        val eq: Int = trimmed.indexOf('=')
        if eq < 1 then None
        else Some(trimmed.substring(0, eq).trim -> trimmed.substring(eq + 1).trim)
    }.toMap

  private def expand(value: String, env: Map[String, String], depth: Int): String =
    if depth > 10 then throw new IllegalArgumentException("dotenv expansion depth exceeded")
    if value.length >= 2 && value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'") then
      value.substring(1, value.length - 1)
    else
      val body: String =
        if value.length >= 2 && value.startsWith("\"") && value.endsWith("\"") then
          value.substring(1, value.length - 1)
        else value
      val pattern = "\\$\\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\\}".r
      pattern.replaceAllIn(body, matchResult =>
        val key: String = matchResult.group(1)
        env.getOrElse(key, throw new IllegalArgumentException("undefined dotenv variable " + key))
      )

final class SystemClock extends hypothesisengine.application.Clock:
  override def now(): java.time.Instant = java.time.Instant.now()
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine.infrastructure

import hypothesisengine.application.Ledger
import hypothesisengine.domain.*
import java.nio.file.{Files, Paths}
import java.sql.{Connection, DriverManager, PreparedStatement}
import java.time.Instant
import scala.util.{Failure, Success, Using}

final class SqliteLedger(dbPath: String = "ledger.db") extends Ledger:
  private val schema: String =
    Option(getClass.getResourceAsStream("/ledger-schema.sql")) match
      case Some(stream) => scala.io.Source.fromInputStream(stream).mkString
      case None => ""

  private def connection: Connection = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + dbPath)

  initializeSchema()

  private def initializeSchema(): Unit =
    val attempt = Using.Manager { use =>
      val conn: Connection = use(connection)
      val statement = use(conn.createStatement())
      schema.split(";").foreach { part: String =>
        if part.trim.nonEmpty then statement.execute(part)
      }
    }
    attempt match
      case Failure(error) => throw error
      case Success(_) => ()

  private def write(sql: String)(bind: PreparedStatement => Unit): Either[String, Unit] =
    Using.Manager { use =>
      val conn: Connection = use(connection)
      val statement: PreparedStatement = use(conn.prepareStatement(sql))
      bind(statement)
      statement.executeUpdate()
    } match
      case Success(_) => Right(())
      case Failure(error) => Left(error.getMessage)

  private def count(sql: String)(bind: PreparedStatement => Unit): Int =
    Using.Manager { use =>
      val conn: Connection = use(connection)
      val statement: PreparedStatement = use(conn.prepareStatement(sql))
      bind(statement)
      val resultSet = use(statement.executeQuery())
      if resultSet.next() then resultSet.getInt(1) else 0
    }.getOrElse(0)

  override def saveRaw(result: RawResult): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO executions (id, hypothesis_id, experiment_id, artifact_version, command, environment, revision, timeout_seconds, exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_millis, recorded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, ExecutionId.value(result.executionId))
      statement.setString(2, HypothesisId.value(result.hypothesisId))
      statement.setString(3, result.experimentId)
      statement.setString(4, result.testArtifactVersion)
      statement.setString(5, result.command.mkString(" "))
      statement.setString(6, result.environment.map { case (key, value) => key + "=" + value }.mkString(","))
      statement.setString(7, result.sourceRevision)
      statement.setInt(8, result.timeoutSeconds)
      statement.setInt(9, result.exitCode)
      statement.setString(10, result.stdout)
      statement.setString(11, result.stderr)
      statement.setLong(12, result.durationMillis)
      statement.setString(13, result.recordedAt.toString)
    }

  override def saveNormalized(result: NormalizedResult): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO evidence (execution_id, hypothesis_id, passed, detail) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, ExecutionId.value(result.executionId))
      statement.setString(2, HypothesisId.value(result.hypothesisId))
      statement.setInt(3, if result.passed then 1 else 0)
      statement.setString(4, result.detail)
    }

  override def saveCalculation(calculation: ProbabilityCalculation): Either[String, Unit] =
    write("INSERT INTO calculations (hypothesis_id, posterior, calculated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, HypothesisId.value(calculation.hypothesisId))
      statement.setDouble(2, calculation.posterior)
      statement.setString(3, calculation.calculatedAt.toString)
    }

  override def saveDecision(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, decision: Decision): Either[String, Unit] =
    val label: String = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, _, _) => "GREEN"
      case Decision.Red(_, _, _, _, _) => "RED"
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => "BLOCKED"
    val gate: Double = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, _, value) => value
      case Decision.Red(_, _, value, _, _) => value
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => 0.0d
    val posterior: Double = decision match
      case Decision.Green(_, value, _) => value
      case Decision.Red(_, value, _, _, _) => value
      case Decision.Blocked(_) => 0.0d
    write("INSERT INTO decisions (hypothesis_id, decision, gate, posterior) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)") { statement =>
      statement.setString(1, HypothesisId.value(hypothesisId))
      statement.setString(2, label)
      statement.setDouble(3, gate)
      statement.setDouble(4, posterior)
    }

  override def missingFor(hypothesis: Hypothesis, experiments: Vector[ExperimentDefinition]): Vector[String] =
    val id: String = HypothesisId.value(hypothesis.id)
    val missing: Vector[String] = Vector(
      if count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hypotheses WHERE id = ?")(statement => statement.setString(1, id)) == 0 then "hypothesis record" else "",
      if count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coordinates WHERE hypothesis_id = ?")(statement => statement.setString(1, id)) == 0 then "DTR coordinate references" else "",
      if count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM experiments WHERE hypothesis_id = ?")(statement => statement.setString(1, id)) == 0 then "experiment definition" else "",
      if experiments.isEmpty then "probability calculation inputs" else ""
    ).filter(_.nonEmpty)
    val hasExecution: Boolean = count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM executions WHERE hypothesis_id = ?")(statement => statement.setString(1, id)) > 0
    val hasEvidence: Boolean = count("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence WHERE hypothesis_id = ?")(statement => statement.setString(1, id)) > 0
    missing ++ (if hasExecution then Vector.empty[String] else Vector("execution with reproducibility metadata")) ++ (if hasEvidence then Vector.empty[String] else Vector("raw evidence"))

  override def resultsFor(hypothesisId: HypothesisId): Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)] =
    val id: String = HypothesisId.value(hypothesisId)
    Using.Manager { use =>
      val conn: Connection = use(connection)
      val statement: PreparedStatement = use(conn.prepareStatement("SELECT e.id, e.experiment_id, e.artifact_version, e.command, e.environment, e.revision, e.timeout_seconds, e.exit_code, e.stdout, e.stderr, e.duration_millis, e.recorded_at, v.passed, v.detail FROM executions e JOIN evidence v ON v.execution_id = e.id WHERE e.hypothesis_id = ?"))
      statement.setString(1, id)
      val resultSet = use(statement.executeQuery())
      val buffer = Vector.newBuilder[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)]
      while resultSet.next() do
        val executionId: ExecutionId = ExecutionId(resultSet.getString(1))
        val raw: RawResult = RawResult(
          executionId = executionId,
          hypothesisId = hypothesisId,
          experimentId = resultSet.getString(2),
          testArtifactVersion = resultSet.getString(3),
          command = resultSet.getString(4).split(" ").toVector,
          environment = resultSet.getString(5).split(",").filter(_.nonEmpty).map { pair: String =>
            val parts: Array[String] = pair.split("=", 2)
            parts(0) -> parts(1)
          }.toMap,
          sourceRevision = resultSet.getString(6),
          timeoutSeconds = resultSet.getInt(7),
          exitCode = resultSet.getInt(8),
          stdout = resultSet.getString(9),
          stderr = resultSet.getString(10),
          durationMillis = resultSet.getLong(11),
          recordedAt = Instant.parse(resultSet.getString(12))
        )
        val normalized: NormalizedResult = NormalizedResult(executionId, hypothesisId, resultSet.getInt(13) == 1, resultSet.getString(14))
        buffer += ((raw, normalized))
      buffer.result()
    }.getOrElse(Vector.empty[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)])
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine.infrastructure

import hypothesisengine.application.{Clock, ProcessRunner}
import hypothesisengine.domain.*
import io.circe.Decoder
import io.circe.parser.decode
import java.io.{BufferedReader, InputStreamReader}
import java.nio.file.Paths
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

object ExperimentDefinitionCodec:
  given Decoder[Runtime] = Decoder.decodeString.emap { value: String =>
    value match
      case "python" => Right(Runtime.Python)
      case "scala" => Right(Runtime.Scala)
      case other => Left("unsupported runtime " + other)
  }
  given Decoder[HypothesisId] = Decoder.decodeString.map(HypothesisId.apply)
  given Decoder[ExperimentDefinition] = Decoder.forProduct7(
    "experiment_id", "hypothesis_id", "runtime", "command",
    "working_directory", "timeout_seconds", "test_artifact_version"
  )(ExperimentDefinition.apply)

  def parse(json: String): Either[String, ExperimentDefinition] =
    decode[ExperimentDefinition](json).left.map(_.getMessage)

final class ProcessAdapter(clock: Clock) extends ProcessRunner:
  private def drain(reader: BufferedReader, buffer: StringBuilder): Unit =
    var line: String = reader.readLine()
    while line != null do
      buffer.append(line).append('\n')
      line = reader.readLine()

  override def run(definition: ExperimentDefinition): RawResult =
    val builder: ProcessBuilder = new ProcessBuilder(definition.command: _*)
    builder.directory(Paths.get(definition.workingDirectory).toFile)
    val process: Process = builder.start()
    val outBuffer: StringBuilder = new StringBuilder
    val errBuffer: StringBuilder = new StringBuilder
    val outThread: Thread = new Thread(() => drain(new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(process.getInputStream)), outBuffer))
    val errThread: Thread = new Thread(() => drain(new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(process.getErrorStream)), errBuffer))
    outThread.start()
    errThread.start()
    val startedAt: Long = System.nanoTime()
    val finished: Boolean = process.waitFor(definition.timeoutSeconds.toLong, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
    if !finished then process.destroyForcibly()
    outThread.join(1000L)
    errThread.join(1000L)
    val durationMillis: Long = (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1000000L
    RawResult(
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine.application

import hypothesisengine.domain.*
import io.circe.Decoder
import io.circe.parser.decode

object ResultNormalizer:
  final case class Structured(passed: Boolean, detail: String)

  given Decoder[Structured] = Decoder.forProduct2("passed", "detail")(Structured.apply)

  def validate(raw: RawResult): Either[String, NormalizedResult] =
    val stdout: String = raw.stdout.trim
    val stderr: String = raw.stderr.trim
    val fromStdout: Either[String, Structured] = decode[Structured](stdout).left.map(_.getMessage)
    val fromStderr: Either[String, Structured] = decode[Structured](stderr).left.map(_.getMessage)
    if stdout.startsWith("{") && fromStdout.isLeft then
      Left("malformed structured result on stdout: " + fromStdout.left.getOrElse("unknown"))
    else if stderr.startsWith("{") && stdout.isEmpty && fromStderr.isLeft then
      Left("malformed structured result on stderr: " + fromStderr.left.getOrElse("unknown"))
    else
      fromStdout.orElse(fromStderr) match
        case Right(structured) =>
          Right(NormalizedResult(raw.executionId, raw.hypothesisId, structured.passed, structured.detail))
        case Left(_) if stdout.isEmpty && stderr.isEmpty =>
          Left("no result payload and no structured evidence")
        case Left(_) =>
          Right(NormalizedResult(raw.executionId, raw.hypothesisId, raw.exitCode == 0, "exit=" + raw.exitCode.toString))
```

```scala
package hypothesisengine.application

import hypothesisengine.domain.*
import java.time.Instant

object LedgerValidator:
  def requireComplete(missing: Vector[String]): Either[AdvisorActionRequired, Unit] =
    if missing.isEmpty then Right(())
    else Left(AdvisorActionRequired(missing, missing.map(name => "supply " + name + " to the ledger before examination")))

object BayesianEvaluator:
  private val concentration: Double = 2.0d

  def update(prior: Double, results: Vector[NormalizedResult]): Double =
    val passes: Double = results.count(_.passed).toDouble
    val total: Double = results.length.toDouble
    (prior * concentration + passes) / (concentration + total)

  def record(hypothesisId: HypothesisId, posterior: Double, at: Instant): ProbabilityCalculation =
    ProbabilityCalculation(hypothesisId, posterior, at)

object RemediationReporter:
  def breakpointsFor(hypothesis: Hypothesis, results: Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)]): Vector[Breakpoint] =
    results.filterNot((_._2.passed)).zipWithIndex.map { case ((raw, normalized), index) =>
      val coordinate: DtrCoordinate = hypothesis.coordinates.lift(index)
        .getOrElse(hypothesis.coordinates.headOption.getOrElse(DtrCoordinate("UNKNOWN")))
      Breakpoint(coordinate, raw.executionId, normalized.detail)
    }

  def suggest(hypothesis: Hypothesis, breakpoints: Vector[Breakpoint]): SuggestedFix =
    val targets: Vector[DtrCoordinate] = breakpoints.map(_.coordinate).distinct
    SuggestedFix(targets, "Revise the implementation at " + targets.map(DtrCoordinate.value).mkString(", ") + " using the failing evidence recorded on the breakpoints, then re-run the experiments for " + HypothesisId.value(hypothesis.id))

object ExaminationGate:
  def blocked(hypothesis: Hypothesis, reason: AdvisorActionRequired): Decision =
    Decision.Blocked(reason)

  def decide(hypothesis: Hypothesis, posterior: Double, results: Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)]): Decision =
    if posterior >= hypothesis.gate then Decision.Green(hypothesis.id, posterior, hypothesis.gate)
    else
      val breakpoints: Vector[Breakpoint] = RemediationReporter.breakpointsFor(hypothesis, results)
      Decision.Red(hypothesis.id, posterior, hypothesis.gate, breakpoints, RemediationReporter.suggest(hypothesis, breakpoints))
```

```scala
final class HypothesisEngine(runner: ProcessRunner, ledger: Ledger, clock: Clock):
  def execute(hypothesis: Hypothesis, definitions: Vector[ExperimentDefinition]): Decision =
    definitions.foreach { definition: ExperimentDefinition =>
      val raw: RawResult = runner.run(definition)
      ledger.saveRaw(raw)
      ResultNormalizer.validate(raw) match
        case Right(normalized) => ledger.saveNormalized(normalized)
        case Left(error) => System.err.println("REJECTED " + error)
    }
    LedgerValidator.requireComplete(ledger.missingFor(hypothesis, definitions)) match
      case Left(reason) =>
        val decision: Decision = ExaminationGate.blocked(hypothesis, reason)
        ledger.saveDecision(hypothesis.id, decision)
        decision
      case Right(_) =>
        val results: Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)] = ledger.resultsFor(hypothesis.id)
        val posterior: Double = BayesianEvaluator.update(hypothesis.prior, results.map((_._2)))
        ledger.saveCalculation(BayesianEvaluator.record(hypothesis.id, posterior, clock.now()))
        val decision: Decision = ExaminationGate.decide(hypothesis, posterior, results)
        ledger.saveDecision(hypothesis.id, decision)
        decision
```

```scala
final class FixedClock extends Clock:
  override def now(): Instant = Instant.parse("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")

final class ScriptedRunner(results: Vector[RawResult]) extends ProcessRunner:
  private var index: Int = 0
  override def run(definition: ExperimentDefinition): RawResult =
    val result: RawResult = results(index % results.length)
    index = index + 1
    result

final class MemoryLedger(var missing: Vector[String] = Vector.empty) extends Ledger:
  val rawRows: scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer[RawResult] = scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer.empty
  val normalizedRows: scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer[NormalizedResult] = scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer.empty
  val calculationRows: scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer[ProbabilityCalculation] = scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer.empty
  val decisionRows: scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer[(HypothesisId, Decision)] = scala.collection.mutable.ArrayBuffer.empty
  override def saveRaw(result: RawResult): Either[String, Unit] = { rawRows += result; Right(()) }
  override def saveNormalized(result: NormalizedResult): Either[String, Unit] = { normalizedRows += result; Right(()) }
  override def saveCalculation(calculation: ProbabilityCalculation): Either[String, Unit] = { calculationRows += calculation; Right(()) }
  override def saveDecision(id: HypothesisId, decision: Decision): Either[String, Unit] = { decisionRows += ((id, decision)); Right(()) }
  override def missingFor(hypothesis: Hypothesis, experiments: Vector[ExperimentDefinition]): Vector[String] = missing
  override def resultsFor(id: HypothesisId): Vector[(RawResult, NormalizedResult)] =
    rawRows.zip(normalizedRows).filter((raw, _) => raw.hypothesisId == id).toVector
```
